sloka: विपञ्चैइम् परिगृह्यान्या नियता नृत्तशालिनी ।निद्रा वशम् अनुप्राप्ता सह कान्ता इव भामिनी ॥५-१०-४१॥
transliteration: vipañcaiim parigṛhyānyā niyatā nṛttaśālinī ।nidrā vaśam anuprāptā saha kāntā iva bhāminī ॥5-10-41॥

translations.english: Another selfpossessed lady, graceful in dance, holding a sevenstringed lute was as though lying asleep with her beloved.
